summary: sdrpp 1.3.0~git20260705.8c9f5ee+lab1: SDR++ 8c9f5ee8 with the build allowlist (radio, audio_sink, frequency_manager, sources rtl_sdr/airspyhf/soapy/file/network, rigctl_server), no RTL bias-tee or direct-sampling control, server mode refused

patches.summary: rtl_sdr_source: no Bias T checkbox, no biasT config key and no rtlsdr_set_bias_tee call; no Direct Sampling selector, the per-device directSampling key is written as 0 and never read, the device is opened with direct sampling 0
core: sdrpp --server / -s exits with status 1 before the root directory or any config is touched (upstream server mode listens on 0.0.0.0:5259 by default)

packages.name: sdrpp
packages.description: SDR++ receiver GUI, receive-only lab build with the SR-RX module allowlist

notes: Every one of the 58 option() calls of the 8c9f5ee8 top-level CMakeLists.txt is set explicitly (check_options): ON are OPT_BACKEND_GLFW, OPT_BUILD_RADIO, OPT_BUILD_AUDIO_SINK, OPT_BUILD_FREQUENCY_MANAGER, OPT_BUILD_RTL_SDR_SOURCE, OPT_BUILD_AIRSPYHF_SOURCE, OPT_BUILD_FILE_SOURCE, OPT_BUILD_NETWORK_SOURCE, OPT_BUILD_SOAPY_SOURCE, OPT_BUILD_RIGCTL_SERVER and USE_INTERNAL_LIBCORRECT; the other 47 are OFF (build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md section 13, build/15 W2 SW-SDRPP).

The module files are <project>.so (sdrpp_module.cmake: PREFIX "", DESTINATION lib/sdrpp/plugins), so the plugin directory holds exactly radio, audio_sink, frequency_manager, rtl_sdr_source, airspyhf_source, file_source, network_source, soapy_source and rigctl_server (receive-only-policy.json components.sdrpp.allow_plugins; recipes/sdrpp/runtime_check.py compares the installed directory with that list).

rtl_sdr_source links the lab librtlsdr2 through lab_build_depends (pkg-config librtlsdr from librtlsdr-dev 2.0.3-0+lab1), so dpkg-shlibdeps derives librtlsdr2 (>= 2.0.3-0+lab1) from its DEBIAN/shlibs; forbid_needed refuses librtlsdr.so.0 and the TX-capable device libraries.

libsdrpp_core.so keeps the upstream layout: /usr/lib, SONAME libsdrpp_core.so without a version, so it gets no DEBIAN/shlibs and dpkg-shlibdeps skips it as an unversioned library of the same build. Only the listed targets are built: libcorrect's tests and tools and the Linux copy target do_always are not compiled.

Lab patch 0001 (rtl_sdr_source) removes the Bias T and Direct Sampling controls: no biasT key is written or read, directSampling is written as 0 and never read, and the device always gets rtlsdr_set_direct_sampling(dev, 0) (STACK.md:888; selftest RX-01c). The lab librtlsdr already refuses GPIO0 bias ON (deployment/patches/rtlsdr-rx-only.patch).

Lab patch 0002 (core) makes sdrpp --server exit with status 1 before it touches a root directory: build/07 section 13 says never sdrpp --server, and upstream server mode listens on 0.0.0.0:5259 (core/src/command_args.cpp:16,18). Selftest RX-03 still refuses any launcher with --server.

rigctl_server default at 8c9f5ee8 is host localhost, port 4532, autoStart false (misc_modules/rigctl_server/src/main.cpp:39-43, 684); the host stays editable in the GUI, so the lease unit's IPAddressDeny=any + IPAddressAllow=localhost is the enforcement (receive-only-policy.json units.lease_required). network_source in UDP mode binds 0.0.0.0:<port> (source_modules/network_source/src/main.cpp:167): the same unit rule applies.

The package version 1.3.0~git20260705.8c9f5ee+lab1 (sources.lock.json) follows core/src/version.h VERSION_STR 1.3.0 of the commit dated 2026-07-05 UTC; there is no 1.3.0 release tag, hence ~git. The earlier lock version git8c9f5ee+lab1 does not start with a digit, which dpkg-deb --build refuses.
CI build only: the package is CI_BUILT_UNREVIEWED; the GUI is never started in CI and tuning, audio and the Gpredict Doppler loop on the Q6A stay device rows.
